parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.slug, p.name FROM architecture.projects p WHERE p.slug = $1;
SELECT id FROM architecture.jobs WHERE project_id = $1 AND stage = 'business-analysis' AND status = 'completed' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
INSERT INTO architecture.jobs (project_id, stage, input_job_id, status, meta) VALUES ($1, 'architecture', $2, 'running', $3::jsonb) RETURNING id, stage, status;
SELECT content FROM architecture.artifacts WHERE project_id = $1 AND type = 'brd' ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH next_version AS (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 AS v FROM architecture.artifacts WHERE project_id = $1 AND type = 'business_arch') INSERT INTO architecture.artifacts (project_id, type, version, content, content_hash, meta) SELECT $1, 'business_arch', next_version.v, $2::jsonb, $3, $4::jsonb FROM next_version RETURNING id, version;

WITH next_version AS (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 AS v FROM architecture.artifacts WHERE project_id = $1 AND type = 'application_arch') INSERT INTO architecture.artifacts (project_id, type, version, content, content_hash, meta) SELECT $1, 'application_arch', next_version.v, $2::jsonb, $3, $4::jsonb FROM next_version RETURNING id, version;

WITH next_version AS (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 AS v FROM architecture.artifacts WHERE project_id = $1 AND type = 'data_arch') INSERT INTO architecture.artifacts (project_id, type, version, content, content_hash, meta) SELECT $1, 'data_arch', next_version.v, $2::jsonb, $3, $4::jsonb FROM next_version RETURNING id, version;

WITH next_version AS (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 AS v FROM architecture.artifacts WHERE project_id = $1 AND type = 'infrastructure_arch') INSERT INTO architecture.artifacts (project_id, type, version, content, content_hash, meta) SELECT $1, 'infrastructure_arch', next_version.v, $2::jsonb, $3, $4::jsonb FROM next_version RETURNING id, version;

WITH next_version AS (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 AS v FROM architecture.artifacts WHERE project_id = $1 AND type = 'archimate_xml_full') INSERT INTO architecture.artifacts (project_id, type, version, content, content_hash, meta) SELECT $1, 'archimate_xml_full', next_version.v, $2::jsonb, $3, $4::jsonb FROM next_version RETURNING id, version;
UPDATE architecture.jobs SET status = 'completed', completed_at = now() WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id, status;
